title: Implement the shared Week frame and cross-device week transition

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

body:
Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/124).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver the Week frame as **rollout position 2 of 12**, around the existing Upkeep, Activity, Event, Persistent and Summary editors. Players can see what remains to decide, consult militia values, navigate independently and understand shared changes without losing any editing or Confirmation capability.

This implementation issue is outside the [Rework the militia UI for ease of use](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) planning map; authored by [Write the Week frame implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/124). Inspected main code at `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`; current authoring baseline `6836fadf2ec5430f725681df1a3fb9b066fb7dcc` adds only Navigation shell inventory accounting.

Own Phase View navigation, Phase Readiness, the reference panel, This phase, the footer and responsive replacements; shared optimistic/save/error/other-player feedback, pending departure protection, week page states and the cross-device transition after Confirmation. Consume the shell from [Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135), including its top-bar integration positions, campaign access boundary, maintenance banner, section navigation and failed-load component.

The [Review & confirm owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/129) owns the eventual review block, Confirmation controls and six-section Summary redesign. Preserve the current `SummaryView` and Confirmation contract during this delivery; no replacement review flow or additional Confirmation control. Apply the approved frame caption/footer changes here; the later owner applies the review-block copy removals and Go links when replacing that editor. The [Upkeep](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/125), [Activity](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/126), [Event](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/127) and [Persistent](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/128) owners replace their editors in subsequent deliveries. Keep their current fields, choice cards, validation, Rules Exceptions and warnings working now.

### Frame acceptance

- Five positions always appear in rules order: **Upkeep, Activity, Event, Persistent, Review & confirm**. The URL value remains `summary` for the last. Week N in the shell and the selected step replace the duplicate **Week N · Phase** heading; retain an accessible page heading identifying both.
- Derive all five Phase Views from one current source snapshot, optimistic Weekly Draft and Resolution Preview. For the first four steps show a check when ready, otherwise the number of open decisions, and a separate warning count when present. Advisory warnings can coexist with ready. Count unique requirement/warning identities within their phase, retaining separate items that happen to have identical wording. Use existing phase facts and message formatters, never a separate rules implementation.
- Persistent remains visible and disabled with **No carried events** when the draft's fixed `persistentPhaseEligible` is false. Creating or ending events during this week cannot change that eligibility. A direct ineligible `phase=persistent` request normalizes to Upkeep. Previous/next skips the locked position without hiding it; endpoints do not wrap.
- Phase navigation is local and remains usable while ordinary saves are pending. Update the local route without disposing/recreating the campaign's draft store, clearing pending operations or changing another player's Phase View. Deep links, reload and browser Back/Forward choose the valid requested Phase View; invalid/absent values choose Upkeep. No phase navigation writes to Convex.
- **Review & confirm has no readiness caption**, including the phone step sheet/current-step caption and desktop rail. In Summary, the footer shows only a disabled-Confirmation reason when needed, such as **2 decisions left** or **Review will be ready when your changes are saved.** It is empty when ready; do not introduce the removed ready/needs-attention sentence. While a fresh review is required, the footer directs the player to review the updated week and does not imply readiness permits confirmation. The existing review controls remain authoritative.
- For other phases, the pinned footer has previous, the current phase's readiness line, and next. Event advances directly to Review & confirm when Persistent is locked; otherwise Persistent precedes it. Readiness is informational, not a lock on navigation. Current editors' required decisions and warning details stay reachable even when the panel is closed.

### Reference panel and feedback acceptance

- On tablet/desktop the closable docked panel is read-only and appears only on Week. Remember its open/closed preference locally as the old sidebar did; do not share this preference or Phase View between players. **This phase** sits above the panel tabs and lists the current phase's open decisions and warnings in plain language. Summary uses its aggregate facts; phase and item warnings remain in their editor as well.
- The **Militia** tab displays **Now / After the week**: rank, training, treasury and its minimum, notoriety, focus, team conditions (active/disabled/missing, without hiding any existing exceptional status), actions used versus allowance, event chance and carried persistent events. Now comes from the current source snapshot; After the week comes from the same Resolution Preview used by the editors, including Table Adjustments where a final outcome exists. Label draft-only context such as actions used clearly; never invent a historical/current value where no comparable value exists. Use existing rule helpers for thresholds/allowances. Distinguish an incomplete forecast with an unavailable/awaiting-decisions value rather than displaying zero or a prior week's after-value as final.
- Preserve the **Officers** and **History** reference tabs from the navigation decision. Officers displays current read-only roster/officer information and **Characters & officers**. Managers remain with teams on Militia. Militia includes **Open militia**; History includes available recent effective finished weeks and **All finished weeks**. Each link keeps this campaign. Use the existing history reader's latest/previous-week navigation for a small bounded recent list (at most three); do not create a new query, fake record dates, treat multiple audit entries as separate finished weeks or scan all history. Its loading/failure/empty state is local to the History tab and never blocks editing. The later Finished weeks implementation owns its new listing query and may replace this adapter while retaining these links.
- One status line integrates into the shell: **Prepare the week together.**, **Saving changes…**, **Changes saved.**, **Changes could not be saved. The latest saved values are shown.**, **Confirming the week…**. Failed-save styling is red plus text/accessible alert; color alone is insufficient. Restore the latest saved values and preserve the existing fresh-review requirement after rejection. Where a server failure supplies the maintenance reason, preserve its ordinary failure presentation.
- Beside it show **Another player changed [phase]** for a remote accepted change. Derive the changed phase(s) from accepted revisions; multiple changed areas must not be falsely attributed to one arbitrary phase. Exclude optimistic local edits, their acknowledgements, initial load and new-week transitions. Shared adjudication changes belong to Review & confirm. Do not add actor identity, timestamps or another backend payload. Remote updates refresh readiness and references while leaving this player's selected phase and focus alone.
- A **Setup notes** button beside the status opens the existing notes only when notes exist. Notes stay readable, including on phone; they are no longer a permanent panel. Use an accessible shadcn popover/dialog/sheet with focus return.
- Preserve departure protection while edits or Confirmation are pending, including browser unload and shell section/campaign/organization changes; a phase-only navigation keeps pending work and does not prompt. Coordinate the shell's guard so it cannot bypass the pending state. Never retarget a delayed save to a new campaign or draft.

### Confirmation transition and states

- Keep every weekly editing input disabled while the local Confirmation request is in flight. Navigation/reference reading remains available; no slot claims, player roles or global editing locks are introduced. Other devices retain existing concurrency handling until the authoritative next draft arrives.
- During the handoff, retain the last rendered week and its reference facts instead of flashing a loading skeleton. For the initiating device the existing Confirm control reads **Confirming…** until the next open Weekly Draft is usable. If a device observes closure before it receives the successor, retain the old view as read-only while waiting; do not allow editing the closed draft or showing old facts under the new week number. Handle rejection as the existing stale-review/failure path, without claiming success.
- When the next Weekly Draft arrives, every connected device moves to Upkeep, updates its local `phase=upkeep`, and shows the short notice **Week N confirmed.** with **Open in Finished weeks** linking to `/campaigns/<id>/history?week=N`. Announce once per observed same-campaign week transition, including on a device that did not press Confirm. No notice on initial load, ordinary revision changes or campaign/organization switches; never infer confirmation solely from a higher week number across unrelated sources. Use existing source/draft identity observations. A delayed old edit must neither affect the new week nor erase the notice. The notice is transient client UI, not a new stored fact.
- Initial week loading renders the stepper/panel/footer skeleton inside the already-rendered shell, with **Loading the week…** available as screen-reader status. A failure uses the shell's **The week could not be loaded.** card and **Try again** to retry the week's subscriptions/data without losing section navigation. A valid campaign with no militia shows **No militia yet.** and **Set up militia** for that campaign. Signed-out/invalid/deleted/wrong-organization/non-member cases belong to the shell's neutral campaign access state, not this no-militia state.
- Consume the shared maintenance banner on every state. Data remains readable and editing is not preemptively disabled because of maintenance; attempted writes retain the existing server failure behavior.

### Responsive and accessibility acceptance

Use existing theme tokens/fonts and shadcn components. At tablet landscape (1180×820 and the existing 1194×834 touch test size), use the full-width stepper under the top bar, scrolling phase content, approximately 320px docked reference panel, and pinned footer. Closing the panel gives its space to the editor.

Below 768px, the shell owns bottom section tabs/More. This issue supplies one **Step N of 5 · Phase** button with current glyph and five-segment progress indicator; its sheet lists all five steps with readiness/locked semantics and no Summary caption. Replace the separate footer/panel with a status strip immediately above the bottom tabs: Training and Treasury now → after, decision/warning indication, and previous/next arrows. Tapping the strip opens a sheet with full reference values, This phase, and reachable reference tabs/links. Keep setup notes, save failure and other-player announcements accessible when their header representations are icons. Summary's strip follows the same caption/readiness removal as its footer while retaining values and warning access.

From 1280px, the week uses three columns: stepper rail, independently scrolling main editor at a comfortable width, and docked reference panel. The page itself does not scroll; footer sits below the middle column only. Long panel contents must scroll within their own available height. At all sizes, reserve space for navigation, banners, keyboard and safe areas so fields, dialogs, notices and Confirmation remain reachable without horizontal page scrolling. The hosted old editors must remain usable at each size now; phase-specific redesigned card grids/wrapping are the corresponding phase owners' later work.

Use real buttons/links, clear accessible current/disabled labels, keyboard navigation and visible focus. Sheets/dialogs have labels, focus containment, Escape/dismiss and focus return. Announce saved/failed/remote/confirmed changes politely except actionable errors; do not repeatedly announce every derived count while typing. Counts/glyphs need text equivalents.

## 2. Decision sources

Read the full discussions, including amendments; later approved decisions override earlier text or mock behavior:

- [What shared layout should the week screen use across phases? — variant A](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876).
- [What navigation structure should the live flow have? — variant E](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831173561) and its [team-manager amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831430773).
- [How should loading, unavailable, failed and maintenance-pause states look across the new structure?](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381), including the cross-device confirmed-week notice.
- [How should the shell and week screen adapt to phone and desktop? — variant B](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929).
- [How should Summary lay out the review, Table Adjustments and the outcome? — approved frame/review amendments](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/110#issuecomment-5844063536): no Review & confirm caption; no ready/needs-attention sentence in review/footer; no applies-the-whole-week note. Disabled-Confirmation reasons remain. Review-block removals ship with that owner, not by deleting its controls here.
- [How should the agreed designs be split into per-area spec issues, and in what order should they roll out?](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504), including shared ownership and staged preservation of old editors.

## 3. Prototypes

| Purpose | Branch and pinned commit | Approved route / variant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Week frame at tablet landscape | [`prototype/week-layout` at `14659d7dc6dc9062098055e29508fa3327912402`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/14659d7dc6dc9062098055e29508fa3327912402) | `/prototype/week-layout?variant=A` — A |
| Shell/reference tabs | [`prototype/navigation` at `76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8) | `/prototype/navigation?variant=E` — E |
| Phone and desktop | [`prototype/responsive-shell` at `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7) | `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=activity` — B |
| Later Summary amendments | [`prototype/summary` at `65d472dcf4bb65094efb97b621c7bbae3ee18965`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/65d472dcf4bb65094efb97b621c7bbae3ee18965) | `/prototype/summary?variant=B` — B; reference for frame amendments, main editor owned separately |

Run `pnpm prototype` in the corresponding unmerged branch. Mocks are visual references, not a data/payload or authorization contract. Apply the source precedence above even if a snapshot still displays an old caption. The loading/error/confirmation-notice decision has no separate prototype. Do not merge prototype code or ship prototype-state controls.

## 4. Capability accounting

The existing inventory describes current behavior, not this unbuilt frame. Preserve IDs and append planned ownership; update current-location and actual coverage columns only when implementation lands.

| ID | Acceptance / disposition | Ownership / handoff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WEEK-01 | Week N plus selected phase replaces the duplicate heading while preserving accessible week/phase context. | Frame; shell renders Week tab. |
| WEEK-02 | Five-step navigation, all-phase readiness, locked Persistent, footer and This phase. | Frame; phases supply facts. |
| WEEK-03 | Player-local navigation survives saving, URL changes and Back/Forward. | Frame; shell route adapter. |
| WEEK-04 | All edits remain shared in real time without claims/locks; remote-change notice. | Frame feedback; each editor keeps existing writes. |
| WEEK-05 | Immediate optimistic preview refreshes values, counts and editor. | Frame/store; all phase consumers. |
| WEEK-06 | One accessible save/error/confirming status in the shell, including phone icons. | Frame; shell placement. |
| WEEK-07 | Rejected edit restores saved values and invalidates review. | Frame/store; Review & confirm renders recovery control. |
| WEEK-08 | Pending departure protection covers unload and section/campaign/organization exits. | Frame plus shell guard. |

| WEEK-10 | Weekly editing disabled during Confirmation, including retained editors and open input surfaces. | Frame plus Review & confirm control. |
| WEEK-11 | Every device transitions to next-week Upkeep without a skeleton flash. | Frame/store; same Confirmation contract. |
| WEEK-12 | Week skeleton, neutral failed card/retry and no-militia setup path; campaign access handled outside. | Frame plus shell access boundary. |

| ACT-17 | Aggregate Activity warning/required-preparation visibility. | Frame summary; Activity owns per-choice warnings and hints. |
| EVT-11 | Aggregate Event warnings remain visible. | Frame summary; Event owns item warnings/Rules Exceptions. |
| EVT-14 | Required Event preparation remains visible. | Frame summary; Event owns per-occurrence list. |

| PER-10 | Persistent preparation and earlier-phase dependencies remain visible. | Frame summary; Persistent owns item inputs. |

| SUM-03 | Keep readiness/saved/reviewed Confirmation gate and hosted control. | Review & confirm owns final control; frame never infers confirmability from count alone. |

SUM-06, SUM-07, SUM-08, SUM-10 and SUM-11 remain fully available through the hosted Summary; their presentation changes belong to Review & confirm. NAV-17/STATE-07 are already planned shell-owned IDs, not new IDs allocated by this issue.

**Signed-off replacements/removals:** WEEK-01's duplicate heading and the prototype's extra History icon are replaced by shell/phase/reference access under the [week-layout approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/101#issuecomment-5831260876); WEEK-09's permanent panel becomes its button there. The [Summary amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/110#issuecomment-5844063536) removes only the named Summary caption/readiness sentences/note, not requirements, warnings, reasons or Confirmation controls. The [state approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381) replaces old week loading/error/unavailable presentation and Reload the week wording with skeleton/Try again/no-militia and shell access states. The [responsive approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929) replaces phone footer/stepper/panel with sheets/strip while preserving every capability. No phase field, structured control, roll semantics or choice operation is removed by this frame delivery.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

**No schema, query/mutation argument, result-shape, rules or stored-data change; no Ruleset Version bump or migration.** Client presentation state/types may expose all Phase Views and transition feedback. Upkeep owns the later dice-total/transfer changes; other owners retain the rollout's specific approved backend changes. Do not pull them into this issue.

Use the current `weekly-draft-workspace` store/gateway/provider and `phaseView()`/phase facts, the existing `WorkspaceSource` and local `projectWeeklyDraft()` Resolution Preview. One campaign has one active editor/store. Derive readiness/reference values during store publication or render/memoization, not by maintaining independently synchronized React state/effects. Isolate navigation/feedback orchestration from presentational components and keep writes behind current gateways. Reuse current phase message formatting so internal requirement IDs, source/revision identifiers and transport terminology never leak into copy.

Current `store.ts` publishes loading when it lacks an open observation; this issue must adapt that presentation during a confirmed-draft handoff rather than reuse initial-load skeleton behavior. Retention is scoped to the same campaign/draft transition and must be cleared on access loss or campaign changes. The existing source identity guards, stale preview generations and transport targeting stay intact. All-phase readiness never substitutes for the accepted server preview and reviewed-revision contract used by `canConfirm`.

Read the existing `canonicalHistory.read` client contract for the History tab/notice destinations; its `week`, `recordId`, `beforeSequence`, `previousWeek` and `nextWeek` already support navigation. This issue may consume those existing contracts, not add a finished-weeks listing/result-date field. If reference data cannot be obtained with existing contracts, flag the exact missing field for approval rather than synthesizing data or broadening payloads.

Membership remains enforced server-side on every campaign read/write; the shell gate is presentation, not authorization. Clear prior campaign/source/notes/reference/remote-notice data on organization/access changes. No global/GM-only authority is introduced. Structural errors still block invalid writes; advisory rules warnings remain advisory unless the current resolution contract requires a decision/Rules Exception. This issue does not change existing action-capacity or other Confirmation rules under the guise of a new readiness display.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Retain all existing `e2e/` scenarios, including direct persistence/Confirmation scenarios outside the inventory mapping. Change UI selectors where approved, preserving assertions and coverage; do not skip tests because the location changed.

| Existing coverage | Required equivalent |
| --- | --- |
| `canonical-workspace.spec.ts`, `support/workspace.ts` | Optimistic/shared edits, independent Phase View, pending departure, save rejection/recovery, stale review, concurrent Confirmation, phase eligibility, setup context and responsive/keyboard/card interactions. Replace old heading/status/navigation selectors with semantic frame controls without dropping journeys. |
| `support/activity-workspace.ts`, `event-workspace.ts`, `persistent-workspace.ts`, `persistent-qa.ts`, `summary-qa.ts` | Every currently hosted field/choice/exception/outcome/adjustment remains operable through new frame; item warnings and Summary review gates remain. Drag tests continue for unchanged editors until their owning approved replacement lands. |
| `realtime-action-slot.spec.ts` | Two devices share slot placement/edits and reload persistence without shared phase navigation. |
| `complete-week.spec.ts` | Confirmation, correct successor week, persisted outcome and immutable history; add both-device notice/history destination assertions. |
| `existing-militia.spec.ts`, `support/setup-workspace.ts` | Mid-campaign entry preserves requested valid phase, setup notes, carried eligibility/context and first-week skip behavior. |
| `access.spec.ts`, `character-ledger.spec.ts`, `support/nightly-flows.ts` | Member/outsider isolation and shared officer changes remain intact through frame links/reference values and reload. Existing character and correction journeys remain required. |
| `canonical-persistence.spec.ts`, `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Real auth/isolation, revision persistence, rollback, stale/concurrent Confirmation, delayed edits, dropped acknowledgements and history facts remain unchanged. |
| `canonical-cutover.spec.ts` | Canonical data/history survives reload and retired backend write paths remain rejected. |

Add focused store/component and browser coverage for:

1. Counts/This phase/reference values recompute across **all** phases for local optimistic and accepted remote edits. Ready with warnings is distinct from missing requirements; failed edits restore values/counts and invalidate review. Incomplete forecast is explicit. Summary has no caption/ready sentence in any frame representation; disabled reason remains.
2. Persistent locked at start stays locked if Event creates one; eligible remains viewable if Activity/Event ends all carried events. Next/previous skips locked Persistent; ineligible deep link normalizes without a write. All phase URLs and browser Back/Forward retain pending operations and do not move a second device.
3. Remote note is accurate for changed phase(s), never emitted for own acknowledgement or first load, and doesn't steal focus. Setup notes are present only when available and usable on each viewport. Remembered reference visibility is local; all tabs and History links retain campaign context; a panel-history failure leaves editor usable.
4. Hold the Confirmation acknowledgement and/or successor observation: old week remains, initiating control says Confirming, mutation inputs stay disabled, and no loading flash/false success occurs. Release the next draft: both devices choose Upkeep and each receives one notice linking to the confirmed week. Concurrent stale loser, failure, delayed old edit, reload and campaign switch cannot duplicate a commit/notice or leak old values into the new campaign.
5. Loading, page failure and retry, valid no militia, shell unavailable/signed out/other organization and maintenance at phone/tablet/desktop. No unauthorized content flash; tabs remain usable after page failure. Maintenance rejects writes through existing feedback while data stays readable.
6. Phone 390×844 and landscape, tablet 1180×820 plus 1194×834 touch, desktop 1440×900: sheets/strip/rail/footer, notes, long warnings, confirmation notice and every hosted control are reachable with no horizontal page scroll. Desktop panels scroll without page scroll; fixed phone bars never cover focused inputs or Confirmation. Keyboard/focus/accessible status assertions accompany pointer checks.

Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint`, relevant workspace/store/component tests and affected required/nightly E2E through the declared isolated-preview harness in `e2e/README.md`. Report actual executed checks and any service limitations; unrun E2E is not a pass. This authoring task changes no application code and needs no deployment.

## 7. Routes and rollout

Implementation depends on [Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135) through a native GitHub dependency. It precedes the Upkeep implementation; authoring-task dependencies are separate from shipping dependencies. Later phase implementations follow the agreed shipping chain and replace one hosted editor at a time.

The page is `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=upkeep|activity|event|persistent|summary`. Consume the shell's existing legacy redirect `/canonical-workspace?campaign=X&phase=Y` and do not introduce another editor. Reference links target `/militia`, `/characters`, `/history` within the same campaign; no-militia targets `/setup`. The confirmed-week notice adds `?week=N` to history, using the shell's already-supported existing-history selection adapter. Preserve reload/Back/Forward and campaign/phase context through old bookmarks.

At delivery keep the current `UpkeepView`, `ActivityView`, `EventView`, `PersistentView`, `SummaryView` and their validators/writes mounted through the frame. Only one phase editor is mounted at a time; compute other phase facts without hidden duplicate editors/subscriptions. The current Summary still renders its existing required list, stale-review recovery, baseline/final, exceptions, adjustments, warnings and outcomes until Review & confirm replaces them. Frame amendments must not require that later implementation to make Confirmation usable now. Its final six-section layout and per-item Go links are a downstream handoff.

Reference History initially uses the existing reader; it cannot wait for rollout 11. Finished weeks may later replace the bounded adapter with its approved listing query. No old interaction is removed merely because a prototype lacks it. Remove each legacy phase view only in its owning rollout after every capability has an operable replacement.

### Published implementation handoffs

Implement after [Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/135). The next shipping area is [Implement rules-ordered Upkeep and compatible shared dice totals](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/140). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

Other referenced implementation contracts: [Implement shared Activity slots and action details](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/142), [Implement rules-ordered Event preparation and occurrence resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/143), [Implement carried Persistent events and shared support decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/144), [Implement Review & confirm with ordered consequences and exact reviewed Confirmation](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/145).

## 8. Shippable when

- The agreed stepper/rail/sheets, reference values/tabs/This phase and footer/strip work at all target sizes around every current editor, with source amendments applied and accessible controls/statuses.
- Readiness comes from the same optimistic draft and preview across all phases, remains distinct from warning and Confirmation eligibility, and respects fixed Persistent Phase Eligibility.
- Shared optimistic, saved, failed and remote feedback is correct; navigation remains local; departure safeguards and membership/campaign isolation hold through phase/section/campaign changes.
- Confirmation remains atomic, reviewed and stale-safe; retained week avoids the loading flash, every device transitions to Upkeep and gets the correct notice/history link, and delayed edits cannot affect the successor.
- Initial loading, retry, no-militia, access and maintenance states follow their separate owners' contracts. No future history query or other unapproved payload/rules change is required.
- All hosted capabilities remain reachable until their replacement owners ship. Inventory current locations/actual coverage are updated on implementation, including new WEEK-19 and shared handoffs; planned accounting alone is not marked shipped.
- Typecheck, lint and relevant tests pass, with actual affected browser/service-contract evidence reported. No prototype branch is merged.
